verdict.rationale: The docs describe paging through a catalog of process guides with cursor pagination and version selection (docs-10, docs-11, docs-28), and `init --dry-run` previews which skill files would be written before anything is installed (docs-8, selfeval-2). However, the catalog covers hosted processes rather than a skills registry or marketplace. Browsing it requires installing the CLI or connecting MCP and signing in first: keyless `process list` returns AUTH_REQUIRED (selfeval-4) and the MCP endpoint rejects keyless `tools/list` (selfeval-5). Missing for 10: a public, pre-install browsable skill registry or marketplace page, search or filtering of the catalog, keyless catalog access, and independent corroboration. [2026-10-14 re-judge parity audit (owner-product lane): partial 4 -> none 0, restoring both audits: the story object is a browsable, searchable catalog of SKILLS, and the cited catalog is the first-party process catalog (plus the arena-command catalog of selfeval-9) with no search or filtering — the object mismatch and conceded absence are unchanged since both audits graded it none. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
